verified_entries.primary_source: arXiv:2606.02907v1 (2026-06-01), Linear Probes Detect Task Format, Not Reasoning Mode in Language Model Hidden States
verified_entries.support: Shows a probe's apparent reasoning-mode separation can be explained by task-format confounds after residualization.
verified_entries.boundary: It does not analyze diffusion identity-lock times, block schedules, active-block recording windows, or period selectors. It can motivate instrumentation-confound caution only.

verified_entries.primary_source: ICLR 2025 paper, Block Diffusion: Interpolating Between Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models (OpenReview tyEyYT267x; arXiv:2503.09573)
verified_entries.support: Defines block diffusion language models as autoregressive across blocks with discrete denoising diffusion inside each block and motivates blockwise generation and inference efficiency.
verified_entries.boundary: Establishes the block-diffusion architecture and decoding context, but does not study active-recorder identity-lock times, schedule-aligned period selectors, or recorder-induced measurement artifacts.
